entities.name: Sentos
entities.description: A war veteran of Thune and later a hermit from An Karras on Shandalar, credited with ending a war by sparing the Elder Sun King.

entities.name: Elder Sun King
entities.description: Ruler of the Eastern Kingdom, famous for his unnaturally long life thanks to the Ring of Xathrid.

entities.name: Ring of Xathrid
entities.description: A ring of Xathrid origin that grants its wearer immunity from death.

entities.name: Xathrid Gorgon
entities.description: A gorgon who breaks into Sentos' cottage seeking the eyes of a righteous man for a demon.

entities.name: An Karras
entities.description: A city in the kingdom of Thune on Shandalar, Sentos' home.

entities.name: Thune
entities.description: A kingdom on Shandalar that fought a war against an Eastern Kingdom.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane on which Thune lies.

events.summary: Sentos spares the Elder Sun King at Fleet Rock in exchange for the Ring of Xathrid, intending it as a gift for his wife.
events.quote: he offered Sentos the Ring of Xathrid in exchange for sparing his life, and Sentos agreed

events.summary: The Sun King orders his men to disarm, and Thune's officers slaughter the defenseless Easterners, ending the war.
events.quote: Thune's officers saw an opportunity and used it to slaughter their enemies while they were caught defenseless

events.summary: Sentos retires to a monastery as a hermit and drinks poison hoping to die, but survives.
events.quote: One evening, he drank the bottle of poison he had bought, and then went to bed, hoping to never wake up.

events.summary: The Xathrid Gorgon attacks Sentos but he cannot die because of the ring.
events.quote: He was surprised by a Xathrid Gorgon pressing a knife to his throat.

events.summary: The gorgon cuts the ring from Sentos' finger, ending his immunity; Sentos petrifies her with his gaze as he dies.
events.quote: Sentos turned over and stared into the gorgon's eyes, petrifying him immediately

relations.note: She attacks him for his eyes; he petrifies her.
relations.quote: He was surprised by a Xathrid Gorgon pressing a knife to his throat.
